page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each of the 80 vCPUs maps directly to a physical core, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 9.6 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

Given its high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the overhead of shared-core architectures. It is suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive data processing applications.
